head.t: Stryker completes acquisition of ZuriMED and adds the FiberLocker rotator cuff system to Sports Medicine
head.x: Stryker announced on 26/10/2026 that it has completed its acquisition of ZuriMED, a privately held Zurich company. The FiberLocker System, a rotator cuff augmentation technology, joins Stryker's Sports Medicine portfolio.

head.t: Stryker invests about $400m in CMR Surgical and takes option to buy it; becomes exclusive US sales agent for Versius
head.x: Preferred equity investment of about $400m (£300m) in CMR Surgical (Cambridge, UK) with an exclusive option to acquire all its equity. Stryker becomes exclusive US sales agent for the Versius soft-tissue robot; CMR keeps development and sales outside the US.

head.t: Stryker enters soft tissue robotics with $400M investment in Cambridge-based CMR Surgical
head.x: MedTech Dive reports Stryker is investing $400 million in CMR Surgical, moving it into soft tissue surgical robotics against Johnson & Johnson and Medtronic.

head.t: Framework ending 29 October 2027: Medical Chart Paper and Ultrasound Film
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Stryker UK Ltd". 5 suppliers on the framework.
